task_instance: Write a new gh CLI acceptance test txtar script (acceptance/testdata/label/label-delete.txtar) covering `gh label delete`, following the skill's conventions (capability declaration, fixture-repo mode, unique resource naming, scoped list assertions), and validate it with the metadata-only test suite that requires no live credentials.
evidence: Cloned https://github.com/cli/cli.git (depth 1) into repo/ to get the real acceptance test harness (acceptance/README.md, acceptance/testdata/*.txtar, acceptance_test.go). Reviewed acceptance/testdata/label/label.txtar and acceptance/testdata/variable/variable-repo.txtar as style references, then authored acceptance/testdata/label/label-delete.txtar with: `# requires-user-capability: false` as the first line; `fixture-repo shared REPO`; a unique `$LABEL_NAME` built from `$RANDOM_STRING`; `--repo`-scoped commands via `GH_REPO`; scoped `gh label list --search $LABEL_NAME` assertions (never selecting first/only result) both before and after `gh label delete $LABEL_NAME --yes` to prove creation and deletion. Ran the skill's documented no-credential validation command from the repo root: `go test -tags=acceptance -run '^(TestSelectAcceptanceTestGroups|TestFilterAcceptanceScripts|TestTokenHasUserCapability|TestAcceptanceScriptsDeclareUserCapabilityRequirement|TestAcceptanceScriptsDeclareFixtureRepository|TestRequiresUserCapabilityForScript|TestValidateFixtureRepositoryDeclaration|TestFixtureRepositoryManager)$' ./acceptance` which produced `ok github.com/cli/cli/v2/acceptance 0.210s` (full PASS, no failures) after ~1-2 minutes of Go module download/compile. Additionally re-ran the two structural sub-tests filtered to the new file to confirm it specifically was exercised and passed: `TestAcceptanceScriptsDeclareUserCapabilityRequirement/testdata/label/label-delete.txtar` and `TestAcceptanceScriptsDeclareFixtureRepository/testdata/label/label-delete.txtar` both PASS. This validates the script's structure/metadata exactly as the skill's 'Validate' section prescribes; it does not run the script live against GitHub (that requires GH_ACCEPTANCE_HOST/ORG/TOKEN credentials against a real org, which is out of scope for this sandboxed, credential-free verification path that the skill itself designates as the buildable/checkable deliverable).
